title: ジャパンダートダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Japan Dirt Derby is starting! Given that it's a regional dirt race, I feel like the mood's gonna be a smidge different from a central turf race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Given the change of environment, will everyone still be just as passionate? Or were the races I saw before special?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna check for myself. I just know this is where I'll find the source of Umamusume charm I've been chasing!
